lead: Kader Khan was an Indian actor, born on 22 October 1930 in Kabul.
He died on 31 December 2018 in Toronto at the age of 88.
He has 60 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Padma Shri in arts and Filmfare Award for Best Dialogue.
This profile collects the Kader facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Kader Khan — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Kader Khan was born on 22 October 1930 in Kabul, and holds Indian nationality.
He received his education at North-Eastern Hill University and Osmania University.
He is recorded as speaking Hindi, Pashto and Urdu.
